description:
What a way to say goodbye to Mestalla. FC Barcelona produced a superb display in what is set to be their final visit to Valencia’s historic home, sweeping the hosts aside with a stunning 5-0 victory. A dazzling attacking performance made it four wins from four in La Liga, with Lamine Yamal (2), Fermín López, Raphinha and Pedri all on the scoresheet — and Barça could easily have won by an even bigger margin.
